scope: Launch planning only; hosted CI connects to existing external source; no runtime or financial implementation
owner: Kiln maintainers; operator retains commercial, source-host and activation authority

scenario_review.method: Agentic document-coverage review, not executable runtime tests or independent approval
positive: Existing repository enrollment without source migration; exact remote commit -> reviewed execution -> Kiln results and upstream status
Successful and failing customer jobs; verified usage under exact class/price
Separate inference request/model/usage and independent activation
negative: Wrong organization or native repository ID, forged signature and unauthorized connection changes
Repository rename/transfer and connection generation drift
Revoked/reconnected credentials, stale deliveries and pending dispatch
Duplicate event and restart recovery without redispatch; retained old replay records
Moved branch, unavailable source and failed/ambiguous status publication never imply substitute source or success
Concurrent cap exhaustion, unknown usage and uncertain dispatch/invoice acceptance retain obligations
Missing model rights, non-overlapping token dimensions, partial streams and cancellation uncertainty
Forged/replayed/unordered payment events and cross-organization content/invoice access
scenario_review.result: Document specifies required outcomes and future executable acceptance; no new onboarding or billing behavior claimed

source_review: docs/operator.md: GitHub credentials, reviewed workflow/source acquisition, durable replay, status and recovery
Historical combined live GitHub/Iroh verification receipt: recorded cohort only
verification_notes: Initial full operator-document read was truncated; anchor check corrected to bounded heading retrieval and passed
cairn subcommand --help attempts did not provide schemas; exact commands recovered from existing retained lifecycle receipts and passed
not_exercised: New remote webhook, source acquisition, worker job, status write, onboarding or revoke/reconnect exercise
Payment sandbox/live integration, charges, company/legal actions or deployment
Customer-hostile isolation, customer demand, current hardware inference or economics
Independent legal/security approval, lifecycle sync/archive or publication
